findings.issue: בְּגוֹרָל is a preposition plus one singular noun, the lot. In current Latin American Spanish, por suerte means fortunately, so the clause adds good fortune and does not say the land is divided by lot.
אַךְ is marked only as an affirmation particle; Mas fixes it as adversative but.
מַטּוֹת leaves staff/rod and tribe open; varas keeps only the rod.

notes: The passive divide, the land, the names construct, their fathers, and the 3mp inherit verb match the other tokens.
